│ The afternoon order goes out at three, and the kitchen closes the
│ tea urn at half past two, so whatever is chosen now is what
│ arrives. The biscuits run out first on Fridays; the fruit bowl
│ is refilled every hour. Water is always there, which is why it
│ is not on this list. Which should be ordered for the meeting
│ room?

❯ 1. Tea and biscuits (Recommended)
     A pot of black tea for six with a plate of shortbread. It
     is what was ordered last week and nobody complained, though
     the shortbread went before the second pot.
     A second plate can be added before three.
  2. Coffee only
     A cafetière for six. Nothing to eat, so the meeting stays
     short and nobody leaves crumbs on the projector.
  3. Fruit
     Whatever the bowl has at three. Cheaper than either, but
     the choice is the kitchen's.
  4. Type something.
